argv: F=$0; for x in "kumitate-shokunin scripts/kimi-census.mjs" "kagi-shokunin corpus/surface-census.sh" "tsukuroi-shokunin tools/tsukuroi-census.sh" "mado-shokunin tools/mado-verify.sh" "kagi-shokunin corpus/checklist-run.sh" "kumitate-shokunin scripts/claims-check.mjs"; do set -- $x; h=$(git --no-optional-locks -C $F/$1 rev-list -1 --first-parent --before=2026-10-14T19:21:00Z HEAD); hn=$(git --no-optional-locks -C $F/$1 rev-list --first-parent --reverse --after=2026-10-14T19:21:00Z HEAD | head -1); b=$(git --no-optional-locks -C $F/$1 show $h:$2 | sha256sum | cut -c1-16); l=$(git --no-optional-locks -C $F/$1 show $h:$2 | wc -l); echo "$1 $2 HEAD@19:21Z=$(git -C $F/$1 log -1 --format="%h %cI" $h) blob=$b lines=$l next_commit=$(git -C $F/$1 log -1 --format="%h %cI %s" $hn | cut -c1-90)"; done
